name: SRUM (System Resource Usage Monitor)
purpose: Tracks application execution, CPU/network resource usage, and per-app network data volume over time, written hourly and at shutdown.
normal_baseline: Reflects normal application and network usage; retention commonly cited as 30-60 days depending on configuration.
anomalies: Large BytesSent volume from an unexpected application, indicating possible exfiltration
Execution record for an application with no matching Prefetch/Amcache entry
anti_forensic_notes: SRUDB.dat can be deleted directly and Windows will recreate an empty one at next write, so a suspiciously short-lived SRUM history around an incident is itself a signal.
